name: RANPAK HOLDINGS CORP.

result.guidance: 公司預期實現先前的全年指引，並維持成本紀律與推進營收成長及毛利改善。
result.outlook: 本季營業收入達到 1.02 億美元，帶動毛利率來到 35.3%。然而，營業利益率為 0.0% 且本期淨利呈現 -0.07 億美元的虧損，顯示獲利能力仍待提升。

result.keyPoints:

result.guidanceOfficial: While volatility has stepped up markedly since the end of the second quarter, we believe we are executing well on the things that are in our control and expect to achieve our prior guidance for the year.
